env_allowlist.PATH: inherited only for pinned executable discovery
env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only for the pinned Elan toolchain location

network_enforcement: The checker performs local structural reconciliation, then invokes check_validation.sh; every Lean subprocess in that replay runs through Bubblewrap --unshare-net with a read-only host root and a fresh writable temporary output directory.
dependency_policy: Reuse the automation-provided canonical pinned mathlib source and compiled artifacts read-only. Do not update, build, clone, fetch, or mutate .lake. This is warm-cache negative release-decision evidence, not cold hermetic release evidence.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED negative release summary

scope_boundary: Self-tests a fail-closed release reconciliation and replays the existing network-isolated trust-zero kernel probe. It supplies no master acceptance, accepted graph closure, H0/R0 review, complete provenance/TCB/SBOM, immutable clean empty-cache reproduction, deterministic bundle, or independent verification.
